model.state_space: 40 W33 ports x 3 internal qutrit/OAM-time-bin modes
model.stage_noise: bounded per-port phase and loss + random small 3x3 internal unitary

classifier: line fraction <0.5 => E8; otherwise dark fraction >0.17 => E6; else A2

moderate_profile.orientation_phase_tag: perfect sign separation in all 1000 line-carrier trials

heavy_profile.orientation_phase_tag: not robust; score intervals overlap and change sign

result: The line+dark carrier classifier survives coherent W33 mixing, qutrit-mode mixing, phase disorder, loss and finite shots in both seeded stress profiles. The optional +++- phase realization of the A2 orientation bit survives moderate noise but fails under the heavier profile before carrier identity fails.
boundary: Seeded numerical stress test, not an exact probability theorem or measured hardware fit. The +++- phase tag is a conditional encoding model, not a uniquely derived optical implementation of the abstract orientation bit.
